rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 5 and 7 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-008, p1-013): the prototype wins by default and a question is raised only when the default does not settle it; here the prototype's explicit, verbatim routing (prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100: the commodity page returns to the hub, review or template review as the entry point dictates) states the design for edits begun from check answers, while the walk-on reading of Commodity details (p3-050-m1) is only inferred from a missing hidden from=review field, and the same page's amend-mode Save and return goes back to the review, so the prototype's stated design wins over its own inferred omission.
outcome: After a trader changes commodity details from check answers, a valid Save and continue on both the commodity page and Commodity details returns them to check answers, carried by the real service's change context (?change=1); from the overview it returns to the overview, and while editing a template from its review it returns to the template. This follows the prototype's explicit entry-point routing; Commodity details' walk-on is an inferred gap in the prototype (no from=review field), not a stated design, and the same page already returns to the review in amend mode.
